decisions.reason: The burner component draws directly on the firm's core gas-radiant expertise and supports its main heater lines, so the firm can keep improving it at low cost within existing engineering.

The halogen heater fits the firm's infrared knowledge, but the withdrawal of the electric panel line suggests the firm is consolidating its electric range, which raises some risk for this niche product without yet justifying a drop.

The multi-model industrial electric hall heater serves the firm's core hall market, where its field-service network and in-house R&D let it read early results and refine the line, making it the likely main electric offer after Product B was dropped.
The hydrogen-ready dark infrared series is a strategic flagship with a documented real-world deployment, builds on core gas-radiant know-how, and matches the firm's low-carbon direction.
